山西省发展和改革委员会关于进一步完善工商业用户分时电价政策的通知

notes: TOU to 2026-04-30: 晋发改商品发〔2021〕479号 (+〔2023〕166号), as restated in note 2 of each monthly notice: 高峰 8-11、17-23, 平 7-8、13-17、23-24, 低谷 0-7、11-13 all year; 尖峰 18-20 in 1、7、8、12月 for 两部制 (原大工业) users only – the 1/7/8/12月 rule shows the 尖峰 window; 单一制 users treat 18-20 as 高峰 in those months. 高峰 +60%, 低谷 −55%, 尖峰 = 高峰 +20%.

Float base = 当月平均购电价格 (one constant per month); 线损、系统运行费、输配电价、历史偏差电费折价、基金 do not float. 尖峰/深谷 stored only where printed: up to 2026-04 尖峰 printed for 两部制 in 12、1月; from 2026-05 尖峰 printed for all rows in 6-8月 (and 12-2月), 深谷 printed in holiday months (5、10月); '—' cells are NULL.

Source: www.sx.sgcc.com.cn 收费标准 column (c40145) – one-page image-only PDF posters; OCR'd with tesseract, cross-validated (component sum, monthly float base, info-table reads, voltage monotonicity, regulated prices by TDP period). 2026-03 / 2026-04 are the 2026-04-03 '调整后' re-issues. 1.5倍 table not loaded.
Layout: 3rd TDP period (to 2026-07) 7 rows (单一制 不满1/1-10（20）/35; 两部制 1-10（20）/35/110/220及以上); 4th period (2026-08 →, 发改价格〔2026〕1077号) 单一制 adds 110 and 220千伏及以上 (9 rows), 需量/容量 change.
